draftLine: FFAI. On October 14, 2026, Faraday Future announced that it and FFR signed definitive agreements on October 12 for FFR to acquire FFAI's robotics assets and business in an all-stock transaction at an approximate $200 million valuation and $2.246 per share. The provided excerpt did not state the closing date, all closing conditions, or the final number of shares to be issued.
